parameters.name: products
parameters.description: Set of products indexed by p = 0,\dots,P-1

parameters.name: machines_stage_a
parameters.description: Set of machines available at stage A

parameters.name: machines_stage_b
parameters.description: Set of machines available at stage B

parameters.name: machines_by_stage
parameters.description: Machine set corresponding to each stage s

parameters.name: compatibility
parameters.description: Compatibility indicator for product p, stage s, and machine m

parameters.name: processing_time_per_unit
parameters.description: Processing time per unit of product p on machine m at stage s for feasible combinations

parameters.name: available_machine_hours
parameters.description: Available machine hours on machine m at stage s during the planning horizon

parameters.name: processing_cost_rate
parameters.description: Processing cost rate on machine m at stage s, in cost per machine-hour

parameters.name: raw_material_cost
parameters.description: Raw material cost per unit of product p

parameters.name: unit_sales_price
parameters.description: Sales price per unit of product p

parameters.name: demand_cap
parameters.description: Optional demand cap for product p; may be absent

variables.name: assigned_quantity
variables.description: Number of units of product p assigned to machine m at stage s

variables.name: finished_quantity
variables.description: Total finished quantity of product p available for sale

constraints.name: nonnegative_assigned_quantity
constraints.description: Assigned quantity must be nonnegative for all product-stage-machine combinations.

constraints.name: nonnegative_finished_quantity
constraints.description: Finished quantity must be nonnegative for all products.

constraints.name: integer_quantity_requirement
constraints.description: Assigned and finished quantities must be whole numbers.

constraints.name: compatibility_assignment
constraints.description: Only compatible product-stage-machine combinations may receive assigned quantity; incompatible combinations must be fixed to zero.

constraints.name: stage_flow_consistency
constraints.description: For each product, total assigned quantity at stage A must equal total assigned quantity at stage B and equal finished quantity.

constraints.name: no_stage_skipping
constraints.description: Every manufactured unit must pass through both stages, so stage A and stage B completion quantities are identical to finished quantity.
constraints.formula: \sum_{m \in \mathcal M_A} x_{p,A,m} = q_p,\ \sum_{m \in \mathcal M_B} x_{p,B,m} = q_p

constraints.name: machine_capacity_limit
constraints.description: The total processing time consumed on each machine-stage pair cannot exceed available hours.

constraints.name: demand_cap_limit
constraints.description: If a demand cap is provided, finished quantity for each product cannot exceed that cap.

constraints.name: profit_components
constraints.description: Profit is revenue minus raw material and processing expense; this is captured in the objective, not as a separate constraint.
constraints.formula: \Pi = \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} u_p q_p - \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} r_p q_p - \sum_{s \in \mathcal S} \sum_{m \in \mathcal M_s} \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} c_{s,m} t_{p,s,m} x_{p,s,m}

constraints.name: compatibility_enforcement
constraints.description: Incompatible product-stage-machine combinations cannot receive any assigned quantity; this is equivalent to the compatibility assignment rule and is retained in linear indexed form.
constraints.formula: x_{p,s,m} = 0 \quad \forall p \in \mathcal P,\ s \in \mathcal S,\ m \in \mathcal M_s:\ \delta_{p,s,m}=0

constraints.name: stage_bounded_flow
constraints.description: For each product, the quantity completed at stage B equals the quantity completed at stage A, and the finished quantity equals that common flow.

constraints.name: machine_capacity_consumption
constraints.description: Total processing time used on each machine-stage pair cannot exceed the available machine hours.

constraints.name: demand_cap_enforcement
constraints.description: If a demand cap is provided, finished quantity for each product cannot exceed that cap.

constraints.name: nonnegativity_of_usage
constraints.description: Assigned quantities and finished quantities are nonnegative.

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the single planning horizon, defined as sales revenue from finished units minus raw material expense and machine processing expense.

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the single planning horizon as revenue from finished units minus raw material expense and machine processing expense; this remains a single-objective MILP.
final_objective.formula: \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} u_p q_p - \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} r_p q_p - \sum_{s \in \mathcal S} \sum_{m \in \mathcal M_s} \sum_{p \in \mathcal P} c_{s,m} t_{p,s,m} x_{p,s,m}
